Download USDM drought data

Source: R/source-usdm.R
download_usdm.Rd

Download U.S. Drought Monitor ZIP archives for Tuesdays within a date interval, with optional extraction of drought-class shapefiles.

Usage

download_usdm(
  date,
  directory_to_save = NULL,
  acknowledgement = FALSE,
  download = TRUE,
  remove_command = FALSE,
  hash = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  max_tries = 3L,
  rate_limit = 2,
  unzip = TRUE,
  remove_zip = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

date

character(1 or 2). Required date or inclusive range endpoints in "YYYY-MM-DD" format, in either order. A single Tuesday selects one archive; an interval containing no Tuesdays raises an error before directory creation.

directory_to_save

character(1). Non-empty parent directory. Archives are saved in zip_files/ and extracted into data_files/.

acknowledgement

logical(1). Must be TRUE to proceed, including for previews. Downloads and extracted files may require substantial storage. Default is FALSE.

download

logical(1). Deprecated. FALSE warns and returns a preview after directory creation, without making network requests. Default is TRUE.

remove_command

logical(1). Deprecated and ignored; TRUE warns. No command file is generated. Default is FALSE.

hash

logical(1). Return a combined MD5 hash of all files recursively under data_files/, including existing files, instead of the download summary. Default is FALSE; ignored when download = FALSE. With unzip = FALSE, hashing still uses data_files/, not the archives.

show_progress

logical(1). Show file download progress. Default is TRUE. Other status and summary messages may still be printed when FALSE.

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum attempts per file request, including the initial attempt. Must be at least 1. Default is 3L.

rate_limit

numeric(1). Finite, non-negative request-throttling interval in seconds, passed to download_run_method(). Default is 2.

unzip

logical(1). Extract downloaded or existing archives into data_files/. Default is TRUE; FALSE skips extraction.

remove_zip

logical(1). Remove archives and their parent zip_files/ directory recursively after the extraction loop finishes, including any remaining contents. Requires unzip = TRUE. Default is FALSE. No cleanup occurs during previews.

...

Reserved for future use; currently ignored.

Value

With download = FALSE, an invisible list containing urls, archive destfiles, and n_files. Otherwise, after optional extraction and cleanup, an invisible summary from download_run_method() when hash = FALSE, or a visible character scalar containing the combined MD5 hash of data_files/ when hash = TRUE.

The download summary always contains success, failed, skipped, failed_urls, and failed_files. The two failure vectors are character(0) when no files failed, including when every file was skipped.

Details

Each selected Tuesday maps to a USDM_YYYYMMDD_M.zip archive at the provider's data/shapefiles_m endpoint. The URL plan does not query directory listings or establish availability for every selected date.

Both zip_files/ and data_files/ are created before a preview returns, including when extraction is disabled. Preview results include existing archive paths and require no network requests.

download_run_method() skips existing non-empty archives and records individual download failures. All planned archives are subsequently passed to download_unzip(), including existing archives, with the selected unzip flag. Paths inside archives are preserved. Extraction errors can prevent a normal return; download summary counts do not report extraction success. Pass data_files/ to process_drought() for USDM processing.

See also

download_drought(), process_drought(), calculate_drought()

Author

Insang Song

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_usdm(
  date = c("2020-01-07", "2020-01-21"),
  directory_to_save = file.path(tempdir(), "usdm"),
  acknowledgement = TRUE
)
} # }
